title: 第1章 入宗第2章 授课第3章 破境
content_zh:
当第七十二声晨钟穿透云海时，整个太始山脉都为之震颤。
那青铜钟声浑厚悠远，仿佛从远古洪荒穿越时空而来，在山谷间层层回荡，惊起无数栖息在悬崖峭壁间的仙鹤。
这些仙鸟的鹤羽都泛着玉质光泽，翼展足有丈余，振翅时带起的灵气波动在空中荡开一圈圈肉眼可见的涟漪。
这些身披霞光的灵禽振翅高飞，在朝阳下划出千百道金线，与太始道宗七十二峰正在升起的玄青色灵气光柱交相辉映。
许星遥跪在祭天坛上，这祭坛通体由整块的昆仑白玉雕琢而成，表面刻满了繁复的云纹，每一道纹路中都流淌着淡金色的灵液。
他偷偷数过，从山脚到这座位于主峰之巅的祭坛，共有九千九百九十九级台阶，每一级台阶两侧都立着青铜灯柱，灯焰呈青莲状，在晨风中纹丝不动。
他们这些新弟子就跪候于此，等待大典开始。
“这就是仙家气象啊！”
许星遥在心中暗叹。
他身旁跪着的新弟子们形貌各异：有锦衣华服的世家公子，有身披兽皮的蛮族少年，还有像他这样的农家少年……所有人都屏息凝神，等待着那个神圣时刻的到来。
空中，七十二道玄青色光柱已经交织成一张遮天巨网。
这些光柱直径超过十丈，表面流动着液态般的灵气，在交汇处迸发出璀璨的电光。
祭坛中央的青铜地砖突然亮起玄奥纹路，那些纹路如同活物般蠕动重组，最终形成一个巨大的鼎形图案。
“咚——”
一声沉闷的震动从地底传来，许星遥感觉自己的五脏六腑都随之震颤。
那震动带着某种古老的韵律，仿佛有一头沉睡万年的巨兽正在地心苏醒。
祭坛四周的云雾开始旋转，形成一个直径千丈的旋涡，旋涡中心正是那尊逐渐显现的青铜巨鼎虚影。
只不过他这个刚满十岁的农家孩子还不知道，那青铜巨鼎正是镇守宗门气运的至宝太始神鼎。
“新晋弟子，入宗大典开始！”
执礼长老的声音裹挟着威压响彻云霄，许星遥只觉得耳中嗡鸣，他下意识抬头望去，看见七十二峰同时升起玄青色光柱，这些直径超过十丈的灵气洪流直贯苍穹，在万丈高空交织成网，化作覆盖千里山门的巨型八卦阵图。

阵图中央，一尊青铜巨鼎的虚影缓缓旋转。
鼎身铭文次第亮起，每个符文都闪烁着光芒，散发着令人心悸的古老气息。
“玄元始三炁，化天地人三才！”
执礼长老的祝祷声震得祭坛四周的云海翻腾不息。
许星遥注意到长老手中那柄白玉拂尘每挥动一次，就有万千光点从拂尘中迸发，如同夏夜萤火般飞向五千新弟子。
许星遥感觉胸口一热，低头发现一个金色光点正融入自己的心口，化作一道细如发丝的金线与中央神鼎相连。
忽然，远处传来清越鹤鸣。
只见七十二只云纹仙鹤排成九宫阵型从主峰飞来，每只鹤喙中都衔着一条金丝绶带。
它们盘旋时抖落的翎羽在空中化作漫天光雨，那些光点落在新弟子肩头，立刻凝结成温润如玉的身份牌。
许星遥小心翼翼地接过属于自己的玉牌，发现这温润如玉的物件竟轻若无物。
正面刻着“墨雪湖?许星遥”
六个古朴篆字，每一笔划中都流淌着淡蓝色灵光。
背面则浮现出他拜入宗门时的画面，一个瘦小的农家少年，穿着打满补丁的粗布衣，眼神却格外明亮。
“这就是……仙家法宝吗？”
许星遥用指尖轻抚玉牌，突然发现画像中的自己竟对他眨了眨眼。
content_en:
When the seventy-second morning bell penetrated the sea of ​​clouds, the entire Taishi Mountains trembled.
The sound of the bronze bell was deep and distant, as if it came from ancient times through time and space. It echoed in the valleys and startled countless cranes perched on the cliffs.
The crane feathers of these fairy birds are all glowing with jade, and their wingspan is more than ten feet. When they flap their wings, the spiritual energy fluctuations caused by them create ripples in the air that are visible to the naked eye.
These spiritual birds covered in rays of light flap their wings and fly high, drawing thousands of golden lines under the rising sun, which complement each other with the rising dark blue spiritual energy beams from the seventy-two peaks of Taishi Dao Sect.
Xu Xingyao knelt on the altar to worship the heaven. The entire altar was carved from a single piece of Kunlun white jade. The surface was engraved with complex cloud patterns, and pale golden spiritual fluid flowed through each pattern.
He secretly counted a total of 9,999 steps from the foot of the mountain to the altar at the top of the main peak. Bronze lampposts stood on both sides of each step. The flames of the lamps were in the shape of green lotuses, motionless in the morning breeze.
They, the new disciples, knelt here and waited for the ceremony to begin.
"This is the atmosphere of the Immortal Family!"
Xu Xingyao sighed secretly in his heart.
The new disciples kneeling beside him had different appearances: there were young men from aristocratic families in rich and colorful clothes, there were young barbarians wearing animal skins, there were also young farm boys like him... Everyone was holding their breath, waiting for the arrival of that sacred moment.
In the sky, seventy-two dark blue light pillars have intertwined into a giant net covering the sky.
These light pillars are more than ten feet in diameter, with liquid spiritual energy flowing on their surfaces, and brilliant electric light bursts out at the intersection.
The bronze floor tiles in the center of the altar suddenly lit up with mysterious patterns. Those patterns wriggled and reorganized like living creatures, eventually forming a huge tripod-shaped pattern.
"Dong——"
A dull vibration came from the ground, and Xu Xingyao felt that his internal organs were trembling.
The vibration carried a certain ancient rhythm, as if a giant beast that had been sleeping for thousands of years was awakening in the center of the earth.
The clouds and mist around the altar began to rotate, forming a vortex with a diameter of thousands of feet. In the center of the vortex was the phantom of the giant bronze cauldron that gradually appeared.
It's just that he, a farm boy who has just turned ten, doesn't know yet that the giant bronze cauldron is the Taishi Divine Cauldron, the most precious treasure that guards the sect's destiny.
"New disciples, the initiation ceremony begins!"
The voice of the elder in charge resounded through the sky with pressure. Xu Xingyao felt a buzzing in his ears. He subconsciously looked up and saw dark blue light pillars rising from the seventy-two peaks at the same time. These torrents of spiritual energy with a diameter of more than ten feet penetrated the sky, intertwined into a network thousands of feet high, and turned into a giant Bagua formation covering the thousand-mile mountain gate.
In the center of the formation, the shadow of a giant bronze cauldron slowly rotates.
The inscriptions on the tripod light up one after another, and each rune is shining with light, exuding a heart-stopping ancient aura.
"Xuan Yuan is the first three qi, and the three talents are to transform heaven, earth and people!"
The prayers of the elders in charge of the ceremony shook the sea of clouds around the altar.
Xu Xingyao noticed that every time the white jade whisk in the elder's hand was waved, thousands of light points burst out from the whisk, flying towards the five thousand new disciples like fireflies on a summer night.
Xu Xingyao felt a heat in his chest. He lowered his head and found that a golden light spot was integrating into his heart, turning into a golden thread as thin as a hair and connecting to the central divine cauldron.
Suddenly, the sound of Qingyue cranes was heard in the distance.
Seventy-two cloud-patterned cranes were seen flying from the main peak in a nine-square formation, each holding a golden ribbon in its beak.
The feathers they shook off as they circled turned into a shower of light in the sky. Those light spots fell on the shoulders of the new disciples, and immediately condensed into identity tags as gentle as jade.
Xu Xingyao carefully took the jade token that belonged to him and found that this jade-like object was as light as nothing.
On the front is engraved "Moxue Lake? Xu Xingyao"
Six simple seal characters, each stroke is filled with light blue aura.
On the back, there was a picture of him when he joined the sect. He was a thin farm boy, wearing a patched coarse cloth, with eyes wide open.God is extremely bright.
"Is this... the magic weapon of the Immortal Family?"
Xu Xingyao touched the jade plaque with his fingertips, and suddenly found himself in the portrait blinking at him.
